en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_PREFILLSTART: If you start mid-chart (checkpoint or editor play), the bar starts filled up to that point.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_USEMAPTIME: Move the bar by the chart's elapsed time, not tiles cleared. It fills smoothly instead of stepping on each tile.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_FILLGRADIENT: Change the fill color as the run goes from 0% to 100%, instead of one flat color.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_STYLE: Modern is a floating rounded bar. Line is a thin strip across the top or bottom of the screen.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_LINEEDGE: The screen edge the line sticks to. It always spans the full width.
